function.name: check_availability
function.description: Find open appointment slots for a service on or after a date. Returns up to three slots with a speech-ready label each. Never offer a slot that this tool did not return.

service_id.description: service_id or service name, eg SVC002.

addon_ids.description: item_id values to include, which extend the job length.

preferred_date.description: The date the caller wants, as yyyy-mm-dd. Use today's date if they have no preference.

time_preference.description: The caller's preference, if they expressed one.
